props.gloss_en: for the sin of a vain oath: wild beasts abound, cattle cease, people diminish, and the roads become desolate
...and for a false oath, the same
...and for desecration of the Name, the same
...and for desecration of Shabbat, the same
as it is stated: 'and if by these [be'eleh] you will not be corrected unto Me' (Lev 26:23)
do not read be'eleh (by these) but be'ala (by an oath) (אל תקרי)
and it is written: 'and I will send the beast of the field among you...' (Lev 26:22)
and of a false oath it is written: 'you shall not swear by My name falsely, and so desecrate [vechilalta] the name of your God' (Lev 19:12)
and of desecration of the Name it is written: 'you shall not desecrate [techalelu] My holy name' (Lev 22:32)
and of desecration of Shabbat it is written: 'its desecrators [mechaleleha] shall surely be put to death' (Ex 31:14)
